title: WabbleSpec CLI Platform Receipt
description: Extends base receipt schema for CLI platform activation and gate verification.

cli_framework.description: Arg parsing library in use (commander, cobra, clap, typer, click, etc.)

distribution_channel.description: Primary distribution channel declared in design-document

spec_template_variant.description: Fixed: cli — confirms CLI templates were used, not generic

verification_gates_failed.description: Gate IDs that failed. Must be empty before Delivery wave.

startup_time_ms.description: Measured cold start time in milliseconds (from gate 5)

credential_controls_verified.description: Gate 3 passed: no credential args accepted

pipe_safe.description: Gate 4 passed: no ANSI codes in piped stdout
